definitions.explanation: The act of turning a vehicle to the left at an intersection or junction.

examples.japanese: ここで{左折|させつ}してください。
{左折|させつ}のときは{巻|ま}き{込|こ}みに{注意|ちゅうい}。
examples.english: Watch for cyclists in your blind spot when turning left.

examples.japanese: {左折|させつ}{車線|しゃせん}に{入|はい}り{忘|わす}れた。
examples.english: I forgot to get into the left turn lane.

notes:
{左折|させつ} is the formal/technical term for turning left, commonly used in traffic contexts and directions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {左折|させつ}する: to turn left
- {左折|させつ}{禁止|きんし}: no left turn
- {左折|させつ}{車線|しゃせん}: left turn lane
- {左折|させつ}{専用|せんよう}: left turn only

TRAFFIC NOTES:
- In Japan, driving is on the left, so {左折|させつ} is similar to right turns in countries with right-side driving
- Watch for {巻|ま}き{込|こ}み (cyclists/pedestrians in blind spot)
